files.data-contract.md: Each job belongs to one tenant and has a tenant-unique external reference. A completion report belongs to exactly one job and may be accepted only once. Retries carry an idempotency key unique per tenant for 30 days. Supervisors can close open jobs concurrently with technician submission, which must return a conflict rather than overwrite. Primary reads: paginated assigned open jobs ordered by due_at and lookup by tenant plus external reference. Reports are retained seven years.
